text:
anya_csm: Heads up team 1: weve been asked to finalize the EBR deck for Brighton Banking next week. Primary asks: account health snapshot, onboarding blockers, renewal risk heatmap, and a concrete enablement timeline. Can we map owners now?

derek_csm: I'll take account health + activation funnel. Will add a short note on support backlog that might be affecting adoption. ETA Wed noon.

michael_sales: From sales side, need a single slide with renewal posture (green/amber/red) and list of exec asks (2 minimum). I can own the posture slide and outreach plan.

anya_csm: Great. Who will capture SSO/entitlement blockers? That's major renewal risk.

sara_ops: I can run a quick audit of the SSO tickets and share the remediation ETA. Will include any outstanding RFCs with infra. Plan: snapshot by EOD Tue.

deck_bot: Quick reminder : shared deck template is in /internal/ebr-templates/brighton. Auto-attach checklist required: owners, dates, customer quotes, demo plan.

tess_pd: For the demo plan, I recommend a 20-min product walkthrough + 10-min Q&A for execs. I can prep the demo script if someone supplies key customer scenarios.

derek_csm: I'll pull top 3 customer scenarios from NPS notes and forward them to @tess_pd by Tue afternoon.

michael_sales: Also flagged: billing invoice delay reported last month. It's on finance but we need to show the mitigation: finance issued corrected invoice and credit applied. I'll confirm with @lina_fin.

anya_csm: Action list so far: health + funnel -> derek, renewal posture -> michael, SSO tickets -> sara, demo script -> tess. Need enablement session owner for power users. Volunteers?

derek_csm: I can host a 45-min power user workshop next week (Wed/Thu window). Will prepare follow-up checklist and invite list.

anya_csm: Excellent. We should include an "ask log" slide capturing outstanding asks and anticipated decision owners + deadlines. Can @michael_sales add that to the outreach slide?

michael_sales: Yep adding a table with owner/ask/due date. Will draft and post in thread.

sara_ops: Two quick notes: 1) SSO root cause is an expired cert on customer side for two accounts; we're coordinating rekey. 2) There is an open entitlement mapping ticket that blocks access to advanced payments bundle. Both are high priority.

tess_pd: For the product slides let's avoid deep technical detail; include an appendix tech-readout for eng. We should show two success metrics: time-to-first-payment and transactions retained after 30 days.

derek_csm: Adding both metrics to the health slide. Also capturing recent customer quote: "Support turned things around quickly, but we need clearer onboarding docs." I'll anonymize and include.

deck_bot: Auto-validate: deck contains owners field? NO. deadline field? NO. Please update before Fri 9am to pass readiness check.

anya_csm: OK team 1: let's aim to have draft deck by Thu 4pm so we can do a dry run Fri morning. Derek and Michael please ping me when your slides are uploaded.

michael_sales: Uploaded renewal posture + ask log v1 to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/ebr/brighton/renewal_v1.pdf

derek_csm: Uploaded health slide + funnel: https://redwood.app/drive/ebr/brighton/health_v1.pptx

sara_ops: SSO ticket summary uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/ebr/brighton/sso_report.docx. ETA for cert rotation: 48-72 hours once customer completes rekey.

tess_pd: Demo script draft posted to thread. Requesting product SME to rehearse with me Thu morning at 9:30am. @devon_eng?

devon_eng: happy to join Thu 9:30 for rehearsal. Will bring a short runbook for fallback flows.

anya_csm: Last checklist item: capture exec feedback as 1-2 bullets per owner here. I'll collate and produce the final 1-page summary for execs.

michael_sales: Exec bullets: 1) confirm finance credit applied (michael_sales) 2) commit to power-user enablement date (derek_csm).

derek_csm: Exec bullets: 1) we will host workshop next Wed/Thu and share attendance list by Tue. 2) Provide revised onboarding checklist within 3 business days after workshop.

sara_ops: Exec bullets: 1) SSO cert rotation timeline 48-72 hours; 2) entitlement mapping ETA by EOD Wed.

anya_csm: Thx all. I'll assemble final deck and ping for Fri dry run invite. If anything changes, update the drive links and paste a one-line update here. :sparkles:
